gearc (?); adj. Ready, active, quick :-- On orde st&o-long;d Eádweard se langa, gearc (gearo? cf. þ&a-long; flotan st&o-long;don gearowe, w&i-long;ges georne, 72. But see yark ; adj. in D. D. ,
